note: The corpus's first VHDL design in parameterized/, and the design that finds hif-backend#90. A generic reaching port widths survives - `generic (WIDTH : integer := 6)` comes out as `parameter width = 6` and the ports follow - but a slice of a parameter-width vector anchored at bit 0 lost its part-select, so `'0' & a(WIDTH-2 downto 0)` regenerated as `{1'b0, a}`: seven bits into a six-bit net, truncating back to a, and a's top bit was left standing. It now regenerates as `{1'b0, a[width - 2:0]}`. Note the concatenation puts the slice on the right deliberately; with it on the left, as in a rotate, the bit the defect adds is the same bit the assignment truncates away and the broken Verilog computes the right answer.
